fusions.name: Tipped Over
fusions.desc: Hooks the target for 15 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hedge-Layer's Fall
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 28 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Cut a Path
fusions.desc: Hacks 4 tiles forward in the direction you are facing, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: One Falls, Another Follows
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
